business_problem: SIDIS needed a data platform that could unify structured and unstructured data from hundreds of sources, support hybrid cloud and on-premises deployments for regulated customers, and keep pace with transaction growth from 1 million daily events across 20 sources to 80 million daily events across more than 500 sources.
solution_summary: SIDIS uses MongoDB as the core data platform behind a universal data management service that ingests and enriches structured and unstructured enterprise data for banks, retailers, and other large clients. The company runs a hybrid model with MongoDB Atlas for cloud deployments and MongoDB Advanced Enterprise for on-premises environments where regulation requires data to stay in country or inside customer infrastructure. Data from hundreds of sources and legacy banking systems is centralized in MongoDB, where SIDIS cross-references it with statistical models, AI-enhanced metrics, and generative AI explanations before exposing results to dashboards, campaigns, and operational users. MongoDB's flexible document model lets SIDIS adapt schemas for each client without major rework, and elastic scaling handles sharp end-of-month transaction spikes while supporting mixed topologies across SIDIS cloud, customer cloud, and on-prem estates.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Powers SIDIS cloud deployments that centralize client data and analytics workloads.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Advanced Enterprise
solution_components.role: Supports on-premises deployments for clients whose compliance rules require local data residency and control.

data_flow: Structured and unstructured data from legacy banking systems and hundreds of other sources is centralized in MongoDB, enriched with statistical and AI-generated indicators, and then delivered to reporting, campaign, and decision-support workflows in real time across cloud and on-prem deployments.
business_outcome: SIDIS enabled a major Latin American bank to access 180 data sources, build more than 1,200 indicators, send up to 30 million personalized emails per month, and turn reports that once took days into real-time insight delivered in seconds.
